text_block_list.text:
On the way back after finishing a race 
together with Mejiro Palmer—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Trainer, there's a crowd up ahead... 
Maybe there's a special sale or something?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! You there, miss with the 
ponytail, wanna try your luck?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a lottery! Well, since you invited 
me, I've gotta get in on the fun. Let's do 
this!
choice_data_list: Did I have a raffle ticket?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it. I got one earlier 
when paying at the driving range.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You know…… I just can't relax unless I 
have all my lottery tickets and point 
cards properly organized. Ahaha……

Her down-to-earth practicality, so unlike 
that of a highborn lady, was 
quintessentially Mejiro Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's turn it together with our 
combined strength. Now, grab the lever!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Bingo party, hyahaaa!! Gimme something 
good, hit the jackpot!!!!

Hyping each other up to the max, together 
we spin the lottery machine.
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
H-Hot springs~?! No way!! Did I seriously 
just hit the grand prize~?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"No... I just joined bingo with a party 
mindset, I never expected to actually win 
a hot springs party trip."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah~, the vibes got way too high, and 
now I'm acting weird~! Calm down, calm 
down, me~...
choice_data_list: Congratulations, I'm so happy for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah…… I'm really happy, but I also feel 
a bit of responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If we're going, I have to manage things 
properly. I need to check the destination 
info, make a travel itinerary...
choice_data_list:
Do you really need something like that, 
though?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really...? Whenever the Mejiros went 
out together, I was usually the one 
getting things ready, but...

If you do that, Mejiro Palmer won't be 
able to relax. So—
choice_data_list:
No preparations. Just focus on enjoying 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"*Only* having fun!? Whoa, that's amazing. 
But... is that really okay...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"During events like this, she's usually 
doing something, so she probably feels 
restless..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
To get rid of this guilt, at the very 
least... I know!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Can this trip be a reward for getting good 
results in the Twinkle Series? If so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do that! If I bust my butt, 
we're hype-partying at the hot springs!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, my vibes are going up again...! All 
right! Let's do this, let's do this...!!

Mejiro Palmer's guts burn bright. Beyond 
her runaway sprint, a wonderful goal to 
strive for has appeared!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, got something amazing! A juicy, 
fiery one is here--!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this hamburg steak... looks delicious, 
but the sauce on it seems a bit strong.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's fine to leave the seasoning up 
to whoever's eating?
choice_data_list: Want me to throw some salt?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, that works, but plain table salt 
might be a bit too bland on its own.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Hey, Trainer. Would you mind 
letting me borrow your room's kitchen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind my way of doing things, 
I can get it done in a jiffy!
(Sizzleeeeee...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aaand done! Here, give it a taste. I just 
whipped it up casually with soy sauce and 
onions, though.
Prompted, you take a bite. And then――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: How does it taste?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, right? Well, it might look plain, 
but it's low in sodium and really healthy 
because of that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess I'll eat too! I made some 
rice and soup, so feel free to join me!

An impromptu, homey dinner party. And so, 
we enjoyed Mejiro Palmer's special 
hamburgh steak set meal.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, that's quite a haul! That's a whole 
lot!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if we're getting this much, maybe we 
should've brought a cart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, a golf cart. I was thinking if we 
had something like that, it'd be handy for 
carrying stuff.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, I don't own a golf cart or a real 
car, though. It does sound fun to have one 
and go for drives, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Well, no point just daydreaming, guess 
I'll carry it myself!"
choice_data_list: I'll help. Let's carry it together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure...? I kind of tend to just do 
things myself, so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Still, if you say so, Trainer, I'll take 
you up on that. All right, let's carry it 
together!

And so, we hauled them to the trainer's 
office and decided to toast and eat one 
each for now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Nom, mmm, mmm...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, so sweet and tasty! Especially after 
doing physical labor!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Eat up, eat up, Trainer! We've gotta reap 
the full rewards of our hard work, after 
all.

Urged on, I eat one. After all that hard 
work, it tastes even more delicious than 
usual.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, only one pin? Well, the momentum was 
great, at least~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever. Carrots are a lucky 
vegetable for me anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yep. Trainer, take a good look at that 
carrot. What does that shape look like to 
you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, spot on! Yup, a rocket! And when you 
think of rockets, it's all about rocket 
starts, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Blasting out like a rocket and runaway 
front-running to victory is totally my 
winning formula, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
When I look at it that way, it's not bad 
at all! Time for some positive thinking!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's eat on our way back.

Even though the prize was rather 
lackluster, Mejiro Palmer didn't seem to 
mind all that much.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I messed up...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Um, hey... Trainer. There's only one thing 
to do at a time like this, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
When you're faced with a reality you don't 
wanna see, there's only one thing to do!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
A runaway sprint! Aah, I don't wanna look, 
I don't wanna look, I won't accept this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
There weren't any tissues either! 
Dammiiiit!!

...Even as she claimed she wouldn't accept 
it, Mejiro Palmer dutifully showed her 
frustration.
